answer: Random peer audit stops clone farms. A new identity posts a 40 POA bond and enters a tundra of scrutiny, where no fake can hide: five random peers audit its first ten actions and publish a plume of evidence. Building 100 clones costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA in bonds, while one failed audit burns the bond and flags the cluster. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns a saffron badge for faster work, so honesty stays cheaper than fakery.
